node_definition.done_when: A test promotes a run in a temporary RECKON_HOME and repository, keeps the snapshot taken before the promotion, invokes the stop hook, and asserts that no worktree-held row is offered for that run. A worktree-held row whose tree still exists is still offered. The current hook, the negative control, offers the stale row. The obligations hook and snapshot test files are recorded as flat baseline_suite and after_suite records.
node_definition.goal: Make the-obligations-hook-reads-a-snapshot §21 hold as its section states. When the stop hook reads a worktree-held row from the obligations snapshot, it checks that row's tree at read time and drops the row when the tree is gone or the run's ledger record says its worktree was released, at a cost of one stat per row.
